title: Course Title Skeleton Repair: Project Management maps stop collapsing

claims.summary: The release is grounded in a fresh deployed v0.15.82 Project Management ZIP/log audit whose exported report and local regrade reached 99/A with no P0/P1 findings and a remaining texture score of 86/100.
The fresh audit exported 12 Course Map lesson titles and 12 topic cells whose only topic was Project Management, proving the prior generic Week repair was insufficient.
proofCommands: course-map-audit.json generated from Course Map/Project Management - Course Map.xlsx

claims.summary: Course-map readiness now treats repeated course-title-only lesson titles and topic cells as weak skeletons and repairs them from assessment anchors or a Project Management progression.
Project Management fallback copy now uses project-specific stakeholder, constraint, artifact, and decision language, and sentence-shaped support fields cannot be selected as Course Map topics.

carryForward.next: After deploy, run a fresh v0.15.83 EduTool.dev ZIP/log audit to verify Course Map topics, downstream filenames, texture, export, and UI caveats end to end.
If v0.15.83 still regrades below 100/100, prioritize the newest texture evidence rather than assuming the v0.15.82 repeated shingles remain unchanged.
